B.rows: union of four lowest clean means, four eligible lowest absolute INT4 means, V00,V01,V02,V03
B.ties: lower worst-seed loss, then numeric variant ID

C.rows: V00,V01 and at most two nominees plus their frozen same-operator SHUFFLE/CONSTANT mappings
C.lr: discovery selected rate; controls inherit candidate rate
C.primary: mean clean CE at 2000..4000 every100; separate1000..2000 report
C.gate: SELECTION.json committed before confirmation; no nominees => stop

nomination.training: best non-V00 mean; better in at least2/3 pairs; lower mean clean endpoint
nomination.quantization: best non-V00 absolute INT4 with lower mean penalty; mean clean within.01 of V00

D.rows: V00,V01 and at most two confirmed candidates

decisions.training: all8 negative paired primary differences, mean gain>=.005, lower final mean, no endpoint regression>.01; apply separately versus M and M-O
decisions.quantization: all8 lower absolute INT4 CE, penalty gain>=.01 vsM or.005 vsM-O, penalty better>=7/8, clean regression<=.01 each seed
decisions.order: all8 favorable versus own SHUFFLE and CONSTANT, mean gain>=.005; analogous penalty rule for quantization
decisions.depth: all3 favorable pairs at each tested depth for relevant primary outcome
decisions.precision_pass: each seed CE increase<=.1 over own clean baseline on same array
decisions.convergence: CE<=3 at two consecutive100-step evaluations; CE<=4 diagnostic; report censored failures
decisions.statistics: paired seed differences, mean/median/range and paired CI; predeclared one-sided sign tests and Holm over every confirmation claim

data_gate: passed: inherited hashes plus new document-disjoint confirmation files reserved; no confirmation model evaluation

quantization.primary: inherited rowwise symmetric max-absolute nearest rounding; all backbone Linear/Embedding weights including untied head; controls/norms FP32
quantization.accounting: absolute CE, delta, perplexity ratio, quantized fraction, unquantized/scale/ideal-packed bytes and dequantized hashes; no packed-kernel performance claim

stops: sampled fidelity misses retained and block qualified nomination
confirmation_control_rule: compose candidate code lookup with separately recorded nonidentity active-block permutation; retain placement/gain indices; deduplicate exactly constant controls before C selection commit
execution_order_A: 32 qualification rows in numeric order;128 pilots balanced in LR-major then variant order;96 discovery jobs in seed-major then variant order, on the selected device
